sourceText: User asked to execute the milestone status-reporting plan so Proof-or-Stop/Lattice can show all milestones and each milestone internal detail while a project runs, with completed milestones first, active milestone expanded in the middle, and remaining milestones below.
normalizedOutcome: A read-only lattice milestone_status command reports a story milestone ledger as completed/current/remaining groups with sub-objective detail, evidence, risks, and next actions.
acceptanceClaim: The CLI can render every milestone row and active sub-objective detail from existing ProofStory/checklist/evidence facts without mutating lifecycle state.
